text:
alex: Hey folks — we need to lock a 60m sync next week to walk the RFC + API/SDK + Console UX screens. I uploaded a short pre-read: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeF_preread (please skim). Quick asks: vote on a slot, call out anything that must be on the agenda, and add any pre-read items you think are missing.

marta: I can do Tue 10am PST or Wed 3pm PST. Happy to lead the SDK walkthrough.

shyam: Wed 3pm PST works for me. Can we add a small perf appendix to the pre-read (p99 lat, throughput)?

alex: done — added a 1-page perf appendix and one `curl` example to repro locally under the "Run locally" section.

taylor: Thu 9am PST is okay for me, prefer Wed if we want more folks. Also added a note in doc about API backward-compat concerns.

eva: if everyone's read the pre-read we could do 45m and keep it tight, otherwise 60m. :thinking_face:

luis: prefer 60m given console demos + Q&A — +1 to keeping a full hour.

design-bot: Poll created: 3 options — Tue 10am PST, Wed 3pm PST, Thu 9am PST. Vote here: https://polls.company/abc123 (expires in 48h).

alex: Goal: final signoff for API contract + SDK surface + console UX action items. If you haven't read the doc, please do before the meeting. Copying the pre-read checklist here for visibility:

```
PRE-READ CHECKLIST (please mark done in the doc)
- [ ] Read RFC summary and API contract (owner: alex)
- [ ] SDK usage examples + migration notes (owner: marta)
- [ ] Console mockups + interaction notes (owner: taylor)
- [ ] Perf appendix: p50/p95/p99 latency and benchmark steps (owner: shyam)
- [ ] Regression/e2e test plan draft (owner: luis)
- [ ] Security & auth notes for new endpoints (owner: eva)
- [ ] List of open questions for the design panel (everyone)
```

marta: I'll fill in the SDK migration snippet and put the changelog section.

shyam: added the perf numbers + a tiny latency chart in the doc.

taylor: voted Wed 3pm. Can we record the session for folks on call? SRE and PM would like it.

alex: Yes, we'll record. If Wed wins I'll create the calendar invite with agenda + recording link + owners. Also adding a short runbook line: `if rollout blocked -> revert toggle and notify infra`

luis: noted. I'll prep a short demo script for the console flows.

eva: flagged one security question in the doc re auth on the new endpoints. pls take a look.

alex: Great — thanks all. action items: vote on poll, mark your checklist items done, add any blockers in the doc. I'll ping again when poll closes and post the invite. :thumbsup:
